kjv: and saith unto them, Peace [be] unto you
note: SBLGNT omits "and said to them, Peace to you" with Codex Bezae and Old Latin; most other critical editions (NA28) include it.

kjv: a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb
note: TR adds "and of a honeycomb"; absent from P75, Sinaiticus, B, A, D.

mine: repentance for the forgiveness of sins
note: TR "kai" (and) against "eis" (for), the reading of P75, Sinaiticus, B.
TR conflates "praising" (D) and "blessing" (P75, B) and adds a liturgical "Amen".
